effects.name: Hit Spark
effects.use: hitVfx: Shoot, Bolt, Volley, Pinning Shot
effects.note: An arrow or bolt bites: steel chips and two bright sparks. Replaces the placeholder Hit Spark.

effects.name: Hit Flash
effects.use: hitVfx: Bash, Slam, Crush, Ram, Smash, Shield Bash, Execute (any blunt melee hit)
effects.note: A chunky white star pops where the blow lands, with ivory chips.

effects.name: Hit Scratch
effects.use: hitVfx: Bite, Nibble (enemy teeth and claws)
effects.note: Three dark claw marks and a few red drops; the marks stay a moment then shrink.

effects.name: Smash Dust
effects.use: impactVfx: Smash, Slam, Crush, Ram (the floor takes the blow)
effects.note: A dirt ring on the tile, dust puffs and stone chips. Replaces the placeholder Smash Dust.

effects.name: Bolt Thud
effects.use: impactVfx: Bolt (ballista bolt lands)
effects.note: Smaller dirt ring and wood splinters.

effects.name: Cannon Blast
effects.use: impactVfx: Bombard, Fireball (lobbed shells, big fire spells)
effects.note: The big one: fire flash, flame tongues, rolling smoke, a dirt ring, stone chips, sparks.

effects.name: Cannon Muzzle
effects.use: castVfx: Bombard (at the Muzzle)
effects.note: A short flash and a grey puff. Spawn it at the caster's Muzzle, not its feet (see notes).

effects.name: Bow Twang
effects.use: castVfx: Shoot, Volley (optional, tiny)
effects.note: Three ivory motion lines at the bow. Spawn at the Muzzle.

effects.name: Fire Flare
effects.use: castVfx: Firebolt, Fireball, Fire Wall (the caster calls fire)
effects.note: Flames lick up around the caster's hands with rising embers.

effects.name: Fire Burst
effects.use: impactVfx: Firebolt (the bolt bursts on the tile)
effects.note: Orange flash, flame tongues outward, a few embers and small dark puffs.

effects.name: Ember Hit
effects.use: hitVfx: Firebolt, Fireball, Fire Wall, Burn ticks (something catches fire)
effects.note: A small flash and embers off the body.

effects.name: Spirit Flare
effects.use: castVfx: Spark, Chain Lightning (wisp magic gathers)
effects.note: Cyan glints gather with a soft glow at chest height.

effects.name: Spirit Burst
effects.use: hitVfx: Spark, Chain Lightning (the spark lands)
effects.note: A white-cyan star pops, cyan shards shoot out, glints linger.

effects.name: Holy Pillar
effects.use: impactVfx: Smite (light strikes the tile from above)
effects.note: A gold ring on the ground, holy shards rising in a column, glints. Tall: reads from the game camera.

effects.name: Holy Flash
effects.use: hitVfx: Smite (a struck enemy)
effects.note: A gold star pops on the body with a few glints.

effects.name: Acid Splash
effects.use: impactVfx: Acid Flask (the flask shatters on the tile)
effects.note: Green drops burst out, a puddle ring spreads, bubbles rise. Glass chips in steel grey.

effects.name: Acid Hit
effects.use: hitVfx: Acid Flask, Acid ticks (acid eats at a body)
effects.note: Green drops off the body and two bubbles.

effects.name: Spit Splat
effects.use: hitVfx: Spit (slime spit lands on a tower)
effects.note: Slime-green goo drops and a flat splat that shrinks away.

effects.name: Heal Rise
effects.use: hitVfx: Mend, (healing spells on towers)
effects.note: Gold crosses and glints float up around the unit; a soft glow at the feet.

effects.name: Slime Heal
effects.use: hitVfx: Slime Mend (slimes mend each other)
effects.note: Green goo blobs float up and bubbles pop. Same beat as Heal Rise, enemy colours.

effects.name: Rally Burst
effects.use: impactVfx or castVfx: Rally (a cry that lifts the line)
effects.note: A cobalt ring pulses out and little banners rise with gold glints.

effects.name: Quicken Burst
effects.use: hitVfx: Quicken (haste lands on a unit)
effects.note: Cyan motion streaks sweep up through the unit with glints.

effects.name: Taunt Shout
effects.use: castVfx: Guardian Taunt, Provoke (a shout that pulls enemies)
effects.note: Three red rings pulse out from the chest one after another.

effects.name: Blink Puff
effects.use: castVfx AND impactVfx: Blink (vanish here, appear there)
effects.note: A violet puff and spirit shards; the same prefab at both ends.

effects.name: Hop Dust
effects.use: impactVfx: Hop, (any landing after a jump)
effects.note: A small dust ring and three puffs where the feet land.

effects.name: Burn Loop
effects.use: loopVfx: Burn, Burning
effects.note: Flames lick up the body and embers rise. Local space so it follows the unit.

effects.name: Acid Loop
effects.use: loopVfx: Acid, Poison
effects.note: Green bubbles rise around the body and drips fall off it.

effects.name: Shield Loop
effects.use: loopVfx: Shield
effects.note: Cobalt hex plates circle the unit at chest height, fading in and out.

effects.name: Haste Loop
effects.use: loopVfx: Haste
effects.note: Cyan streaks trail off the unit toward the ground, like a sprinter.

effects.name: Rallied Loop
effects.use: loopVfx: Rallied
effects.note: An occasional gold glint over the unit and a slow cobalt ring at the feet.

effects.name: Taunted Loop
effects.use: loopVfx: Taunted
effects.note: Red eye-motes pulse above the head, drifting toward the taunter's direction is not needed: just angry dots.

effects.name: Gorged Loop
effects.use: loopVfx: Gorged
effects.note: Slow fat green bubbles burp up from a fed slime.

effects.name: Rooted Loop
effects.use: loopVfx: Rooted
effects.note: Bark shards stand around the feet with a little dirt; mostly static, so a slow rate and long life.

effects.name: Enraged Loop
effects.use: loopVfx: Enraged
effects.note: Red steam puffs rise off the shoulders.

effects.name: Spawn Pop
effects.use: EntitySpawned / EntityResurrected (needs a hook in SpawnPresenter)
effects.note: A dust ring and ivory glints as the miniature pops onto the board.

effects.name: Death Poof
effects.use: EntityDied (needs a hook in DeathPresenter / the Die clip's end)
effects.note: Dark puffs and a ring swallow the model as it shrinks away.

effects.name: Collision Thud
effects.use: Collision (push into a wall or another unit; needs a hook)
effects.note: A short dust puff at the contact point.

effects.name: Arrow Trail
effects.use: trail: Arrow Blender, Ballista Bolt Blender
effects.note: A few ivory motion lines behind the shaft. World space so they stay behind.

effects.name: Cannon Trail
effects.use: trail: Cannon Shell Blender
effects.note: Grey smoke puffs that linger in the air.

effects.name: Fire Orb Trail
effects.use: trail: Fire Orb Blender
effects.note: Flames and embers stream off the orb.

effects.name: Acid Flask Trail
effects.use: trail: Acid Flask Blender
effects.note: Green drips fall off the flask as it tumbles.

effects.name: Spit Trail
effects.use: trail: Spit Glob Blender
effects.note: Slime drops trailing the glob.

effects.name: Wisp Spark Trail
effects.use: trail: Wisp Spark Blender
effects.note: Cyan glints sparkle off the spark.
